## Scope and boundaries

- [ ] Commercial/business logic remains outside evaluator-core
- [ ] Trust, safety, security, privacy, and operational effects considered

## Validation
- [ ] Unit/integration/security/evaluator tests run where applicable
- [ ] Exact checks and results are documented
- [ ] Not-run checks and reasons are documented
- [ ] Relative links, examples, and provider references checked for docs-only changes

## Governance
- [ ] ADR created/updated if an architectural or semantic decision changed
- [ ] ADR index updated when applicable
- [ ] Agent session report added under docs/agents/sessions/
- [ ] User-facing statements do not imply provider caching, indexing, or citation guarantees

## Risks and follow-up
Describe known gaps, migration needs, rollback, and owner decisions.
